quarterly_data.signal: Capacity plan stated with the proposed share placement (conditional on the placement): UMS intends to expand manufacturing capabilities in Penang, Malaysia with advanced automation to support strong and growing demand for its products and address manpower shortages (Penang volume production began in January 2024; additional industrial land next to the plant was acquired in July 2024), and to fund projects in Vietnam and Singapore, including acquiring or leasing a new factory in Vietnam and setting up a manufacturing line to expand capacity, plus automation in Singapore.
